_comment: Raptor's egg library (library/README.md). Based on the NATS egg in https://github.com/pterodactyl/application-eggs (MIT).
name: NATS
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: NATS is a fast messaging system for publish and subscribe, request and reply, and streams. Downloads the official nats-server release, with JetStream persistence and an optional login.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# NATS: downloads nats-server from its GitHub releases, checked against
# GitHub's SHA-256. nats.conf and the JetStream data are never touched.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
# Downloads unpack in a folder in the server's (the install's /tmp is
# small), removed when the script ends.
work=/mnt/server/.raptor-build
rm -rf "$work" && mkdir -p "$work"
trap 'rm -rf "$work"' EXIT

case "$(uname -m)" in
    x86_64) arch=amd64 ;;
    aarch64) arch=arm64 ;;
    *) echo "NATS has no build for this CPU ($(uname -m))."; exit 1 ;;
esac

version="${VERSION:-latest}"
[ "$version" = latest ] || version="v${version#v}"
# gh-release says why when the release doesn't exist or GitHub can't be reached.
tag=$(gh-release tag nats-io/nats-server "$version") || exit 1
asset="nats-server-${tag}-linux-${arch}.tar.gz"

if [ -x nats-server ] && [ "$(cat .nats-version 2>/dev/null)" = "$tag" ]; then
    echo "NATS $tag is already installed."
else
    echo "Downloading NATS $tag."
    gh-release download nats-io/nats-server "$tag" "$asset" $work/nats.tar.gz
    tar -xzf $work/nats.tar.gz -C $work
    install -m 0755 "$work/nats-server-${tag}-linux-${arch}/nats-server" nats-server.new
    mv -f nats-server.new nats-server
    echo "$tag" > .nats-version
fi

if [ ! -f nats.conf ]; then
    cat > nats.conf <<'EOF'
# NATS configuration: https://docs.nats.io/running-a-nats-service/configuration
# The port, JetStream and the login are set by the server's settings.
server_name: nats
max_payload: 1MB
EOF
fi
mkdir -p data
echo "Installed NATS $tag."

variables.name: Version
variables.description: The nats-server version to install, such as 2.15.3, or latest.

variables.name: JetStream
variables.description: Turn on JetStream, which stores streams and key-value data in the data folder.

variables.name: Username
variables.description: A username clients must log in with. Leave it empty for no login.

variables.name: Password
variables.description: The password that goes with the username.

variables.name: Token
variables.description: A token clients must send instead of a username and password. Leave it empty for none.
